title: 第447章 滚远点第446章 后山的驴
slug: 寡村寡事第446章后山的驴
content_zh:
柳大春推开了门。
“柳医生，我闺女怎么样？”唐茹夜着急的问道。
“我已经帮她缓过来了，不过，只是暂缓之策，还没找到根治的方法。”柳大春解释道。
“好，没事，辛苦你了柳医生。你看医药费怎么算？”唐茹夜急忙询问道。
“婉清的气血太虚了，我给她开些补气血的中药，她先调理身体。”柳大春说道。
“好，谢谢柳医生。”唐茹夜很感激。
看到唐婉清从内屋出来，男友徐志雷也是急忙迎上去查看她的情况。
唐茹夜则送柳大春离开。
“柳医生，你说我该怎么谢你？”唐茹夜很感恩的询问道。
“呵呵，你不是说，我救了你闺女，你什么都答应我吗？”柳大春打趣着说道。
“嗯。”唐茹夜点点头。
“那就先欠着吧，等我哪天想到了，再跟你说。”柳大春笑着说道。
“行。”
唐茹夜跟着柳大春来到了家里，柳大春给她抓了中药，吩咐她平时怎么吃。
“柳医生，如果我闺女下次还犯病怎么办？”唐茹夜认真问道。
“嗯，你来找我。”
“好好。那我就先回去了。”唐茹夜这才离开。
柳大春看着这个熟妇的身材，心中感慨：“这唐家的女人，熊是真大啊，真性感。”
“盯着人家的身材看啊？”
师兄从身后冒了出来，神神秘秘的问道。

“呵呵。”柳大春摸了摸脑袋，有些尴尬。
“唐家的女人，身材好吧？那么巨大的熊，你们男人喜欢死了吧？？”师娘杨桃花开玩笑道。
“师娘，瞧你说的，我最喜欢的，还是师娘你。”柳大春嘴巴甜甜的说道。
“不过唐家的女人，身材是真不错，那唐茹夜啊在抖音上还是网红呢！”师娘杨桃花打趣着说道。
“擦边吗？”
“嗯。”
“抖音上的老色逼就喜欢看这种巨褥巨臀的女人了，何况还是大熟女。”柳大春明白男人的那点小心思。
“好了，吃晚饭吧。”师娘杨桃花说道。
“今天吃饭这么早，现在才五点呢。”
“天热，早点吃了凉快凉快。”
柳大春坐了下来，看到一桌子的菜，很诧异：“师娘，伙食这么好啊？”
“可不是，现在村民有好吃的好喝的，都往我们家送，腊肉啊，鸡鸭，鸡蛋，西瓜，各种蔬菜。师娘都不好意思接。又没啥东西可送出去的。”师娘杨桃花尴尬说道。
“没事，大不了我看病便宜点或者不收诊费。算是回报他们。”柳大春解释道。
“嗯嗯，师娘真没想到，你长大了这么有出息，把村里搞这么好，大家都爱戴你。”师娘欣慰着说道。
柳大春把从蝎那边搜刮过来的钱，对村里做了建设，修路，修危房，修凉亭等等，村民自然喜欢。
content_en:
Liu Dachun opened the door.
"Doctor Liu, how is my daughter?" Tang Ruye asked anxiously.
"I have helped her recover, but it is only a temporary measure and I have not found a radical cure yet." Liu Dachun explained.
"Okay, it's okay. Thank you for your hard work, Doctor Liu. How do you calculate the medical expenses?" Tang Ruye asked hurriedly.
"Wanqing's qi and blood are too weak. I will prescribe her some Chinese medicine to replenish qi and blood, and she will take care of her body first," Liu Dachun said.
"Okay, thank you Doctor Liu." Tang Ruye was very grateful.
Seeing Tang Wanqing coming out of the inner room, her boyfriend Xu Zhilei hurriedly went to check on her.
Tang Ruye sent Liu Dachun away.
"Doctor Liu, how should I thank you?" Tang Ruye asked gratefully.
"Haha, didn't you say that after I saved your daughter, you would promise me everything?" Liu Dachun said jokingly.
"Yeah." Tang Ruye nodded.
"Then I'll owe it to you now. I'll tell you when I think of it one day." Liu Dachun said with a smile.
"Okay."
Tang Ruye followed Liu Dachun to her home. Liu Dachun gave her some Chinese medicine and told her how to take it.
"Doctor Liu, what if my daughter gets sick again next time?" Tang Ruye asked seriously.
"Well, you come to me."
"Okay. Then I'll go back first." Tang Ruye then left.
Liu Dachun looked at the figure of this mature woman and sighed in his heart: "This woman from the Tang family is so big and sexy."
"Staring at other people's figures?"
The senior brother appeared from behind and asked mysteriously.
"Haha." Liu Dachun touched his head, feeling a little embarrassed.
"How is the figure of the Tang family woman? You men would love such a huge bear, right?" Yang Taohua, the master's wife, joked.
"Master's wife, look what you said, I like you the most, Master's wife." Liu Dachun said sweetly.
"But the women of the Tang family have really good figures, and Tang Ruye is still an internet celebrity on Douyin!" Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said jokingly.
"Breaking the edge?"
"Yeah."
"The old perverts on Douyin like to see women with huge breasts and big butts, let alone mature women." Liu Dachun understood the man's little thoughts.
"Okay, let's have dinner." Master Yang Taohua said.
"It's so early to eat today, it's only five o'clock."
"It's hot, let's eat breakfast to cool down."
Liu Dachun sat down and was surprised when he saw the dishes on the table: "Master Wife, is the food so good?"
"No, now the villagers are sending delicious food to our house, such as bacon, chickens, ducks, eggs, watermelons, and all kinds of vegetables. The master's wife is too embarrassed to accept it. There is nothing to give away." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said awkwardly.
"It's okay. At worst, my medical treatment will be cheaper or I won't charge any fees. It's a way of repaying them." Liu Dachun explained.
"Hmm, Master Wife, I really didn't expect you to be so promising when you grow up, to do such a good job in the village, and everyone loves you." Master Wife said happily.
Liu Dachun used the money he collected from Xie to build the village, building roads, repairing dilapidated houses, building pavilions, etc. The villagers naturally liked it.
